summary: Vista Energy filed a Form 6-K with the SEC announcing the filing of its Sustainability-Related Financial Disclosures Report for the year ended December 31, 2025 with the Mexican Stock Exchange and CNBV under Mexican securities law. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, management change, or other special situation event is disclosed. The report is a routine non-financial disclosure. This is a routine filing with no deal terms or corporate action of the type covered.
